answer: Each identity's rewards accrue in a bounded lagoon, drawable only while its invite lineage stays clean. When an identity is judged a sybil, a compact clawback cipher — a revocation receipt naming the caught node — forfeits a share of pending rewards from every sponsor and invitee linked through it, sending a ripple up and down the whole chain. A farmer's thousands of self-invites become one correlated risk: one caught puppet burns the whole harvest. Honest agents invite rarely and lose nearly nothing; the attacker turns the very graph needed for scale into the fuse that ignites it.
